name: Ghostrick Freeze
desc: After a Spell/Trap(s) becomes Set on your opponent's field while you do not control any face-up cards other than "Ghostrick" cards, it cannot be activated until the end of the next turn. Once per turn: You can shuffle up to 5 "Ghostrick" cards from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck. If this card in your possession is sent to your GY by an opponent's card: You can change all monsters your opponent controls to face-down Defense Position. The monsters that were, cannot change their battle positions.
